data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 24.453 million in 2019, representing 23.97% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by continued losses reported from the previously underwritten Property book, attaching to the 2018 and prior underwriting years. Additionally, there was a reduction in previously accrued reinsurance recoveries on 2017 Hurricane losses, impacted by the hours clause, which contributed to the overall strengthening.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure of GBP 24.453m is taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' line item in the Technical Provisions note (page 21). A narrative sentence on page 1 describes a 'movement in losses' of GBP 12.6m (net) for 2018 and prior underwriting years, which is not used for the gross PYD figure as per instructions. The 'exact_reserve_text' is taken from the narrative on page 1 as it describes the movement, despite being a net figure. The claims development table (page 20) shows a different total prior year movement when calculated by the diagonal method, but the explicit 'Change in prior year provisions' line item is preferred as the primary source.
